context: Yuki and Kenji coordinate a team message.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: workplace coordination; communication vocabulary (メッセージ/全員/正しい/思え/まさに) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 全員に、お知らせを送りたいんです。
lines.en: I want to send a notice to everyone.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: メッセージは、もう作りましたか?
lines.en: Have you made the message yet?
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、この文で正しいでしょうか?
lines.style: careful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まさに、これで完璧だと思えます。
lines.en: Indeed, this seems perfect to me.
lines.style: reassuring office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 全員に、同時に届きますか?
lines.en: Will it reach everyone at once?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、一度で全員に送れます。
lines.en: Yes, you can send to everyone at once.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 内容が正しいか、もう一度確認します。
lines.en: I'll check once more if the content is correct.
lines.style: diligent office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まさに、その慎重さが大事ですよ。
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
